The heater now has a half-degree dead band either side of the target. Replaying last night's log gives 2 relay switches instead of 12: on at 04:26 (19.3°C) and off at 04:40 (20.6°C).

The half degree is `HYSTERESIS_C = 0.5`, right under `TARGET_C` in `greenhouse.py`. `heater_on` now takes the relay's current state as well as the temperature, so it can tell which threshold applies.

- **Exact thresholds count as reached:** a reading of exactly 20.5 turns the heater off, and exactly 19.5 turns it on.
- **Startup:** the relay starts off, so if the controller boots with the temperature between 19.5 and 20.5 the heater stays off until it drops to 19.5.
- **Controller on the Pi:** I only changed this file; if it runs a separate copy of the decision, it needs the same change, including passing the relay state into `heater_on`.
